0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Lonuhali requires a swift pair of legs for an urgent delivery.

48.original: Welcome, honored visitor! Thanks to your efforts, the reeds grow robust, and at last I can make reed dumplings again. Oh, they're every bit as delicious as I remember!

49.original: Although I want nothing more than to eat until my belly bursts, I've saved a batch for those who are planning the reconstruction of the great stairs. I'm much too full to make such a journey, however─might you deliver them in my stead?

50.original: Surely my friends will be glad to receive them from the very <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who revitalized Ok'hanu's festive spirit!

51.original: Thank you, thank you! They can be found working hard near the Flight of We Wingless. Hurry before the dumplings cool!

52.original: The dumplings are cooling as we speak─hurry and take them to my friends at the Flight of We Wingless!

53.original: Oh, I recognize you─you travel with Wuk Lamat, yes? Have you come to see our progress on the great stairs?

54.original: Dumplings!? Oh, how long has it been since I last smelled that heavenly aroma...?

55.original: When the reeds sprouted big and tall, we had cause to celebrate often, and it was a common scent in Ok'hanu. To have these delivered by one who helped those days to return is a great honor indeed!

56.original: This project will cause my feathers to fall out one by one, mark my words... Where do we even begin?

57.original: Lonuhali made her famous dumplings!? These are just what I needed...such a large undertaking makes one so very hungry!

58.original: With my energies restored, I've come to a realization. Our reed problem required the perspective of visitors to solve, so perhaps we should consult artisans from other clans for advice on how to repair the great stairs.

59.original: Ohokaliy! Apologies, but this area is still impassable.

60.original: You brought reed dumplings!? Just as I was about to keel over from hunger, a kind soul appears from the wilderness to save me!

61.original: This passage is of great importance to us, since no small number of merchants use it to reach Ok'hanu. With delicious dumplings to fuel me, I can now tackle this problem with renewed energy!

62.original: It's been too long since there were enough extra reeds to make dumplings. Thank you for reminding me that better times are upon us!

63.original: Your gift has blessed me with a fresh idea. This may be the first step towards finally repairing the great stairs.

64.original: While this area can be reached by water routes, the stairs are a much less strenuous journey for all involved. With hunger no longer a distraction, I hope I can finally solve the problem of their reconstruction.

65.original: Thank you for delivering the dumplings! I hope they give my friends the energy to complete the daunting task ahead of them.

66.original: Reed dumplings are considered a delicacy among the Hanuhanu, and for good reason. I would like nothing more than to make a batch for our other wingless brethren who aid with the rebuilding, but I realize that not all peoples love their flavor as much as we do...

67.original: But that doesn't mean I can't send a different gift to show my appreciation. I intend to send a nice haul of fish their way!

68.original: You don't seem the type to munch on reeds, either, so I've prepared something else for your reward─cold, hard coin!
